categories.name: AI evaluation & observability
categories.description: Test prompts and agents, inspect traces, and monitor AI application quality.
categories.question: How do I compare AI evaluation tools?
categories.answer: Choose representative tasks and failure cases, then compare tracing, evaluator calibration, dataset management, retention, and full usage costs. Human review helps identify where automated evaluation misses important errors.

categories.name: AI memory & retrieval
categories.description: Connect AI agents to persistent context, knowledge graphs, and vector retrieval.
categories.question: What should I test in AI memory and retrieval tools?
categories.answer: Test retrieval quality on your own information, including access restrictions and outdated documents. Confirm deletion, retention, indexing updates, embedding costs, and how the application handles missing evidence.
